messages:
ana: @channel Heads-up: rolling out SSO changes next week — we are shortening SSO session lifetime to 8h (was 30d) and starting automated rotation of service-account / CI tokens for GitHub Apps. Planned rollout: Tue 2026-03-31 02:00 UTC. Expect short auth hiccups for some runners. Full plan + rollback in doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/sso-rotation :warning:
jeff: Quick q — does this hit personal dev logins or only service/service-account tokens?
sam: Will CI workflows using GitHub App auth automatically get new tokens, or do we need to change secrets in repos?
ana: (typo) ana: Sorry typo above — answer: personal sessions will be affected (you may need to re-login more often). The rotation primarily targets service accounts and app tokens; GitHub App tokens used by runner pool will be rotated centrally. Repositories using PATs must rotate manually. See "Impact" section in the doc.
maria: If jobs fail during the rotation window, will the autoscaler retry or will we see hard failures like last time?
paul: Autoscaler retries, but short 401s are possible. We'll run a 30-min maintenance window and have a legacy-token fallback for critical queues. Ops will monitor.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-31T02:00:00Z — infra/rotate-service-accounts (owner: paul). ETA ~20m. Status: queued.
sam: What should devs do before Tue to avoid surprises? Steps?
ana: ana: Quick checklist for engineers:
  1) Check if your repo/workflow uses a PAT — run: `gh secret list --repo org/repo` to inspect; rotate PATs if present.
  2) For self-hosted runners, ensure they have the latest `okta-svc-auth` sidecar (v1.4.0) — we push the image automatically but verify with `docker inspect okta-svc-auth`.
  3) Test local re-login: `okta login` and confirm you can get a session.
  4) Join office hours Mon 2026-03-30 16:00 PST if you have questions (link in doc).
jeff: Can you post the list of repos we flagged as using PATs? I'll triage high-risk ones.
nana: ana: Yup — posted the export to the shared sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/pat-repos-2026-03-rotation. Also added per-repo owner column.
paul: I'll notify #eng-oncall and be on pager duty for the 02:00 UTC window. Will also open a quick incident channel if anything spikes.
maria: I'll add a smoke test in canary pipelines to hit the auth endpoint right after rotation and fail fast if we see auth regressions.
sam: Thanks — if someone needs a small script to replace PATs with app-auth, I can share a starter.
nana: ana: please do, that'd help. Final note: label any tickets as `sso-rotation` and ping me directly for urgent rollback. Appreciate the help, team :thumbsup:
